<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—dominant peak at m/z 114.07 with a ~6.7 % M+1 peak and a smaller ~0.6 % M+2 peak—the pattern is consistent with contributions from multiple ^13C atoms (≈1.1 % per carbon) and a single ^34S isotope (~4.2 % for M+2). This indicates the presence of carbon and sulfur, which can be definitively identified from the spectrum.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'S']</final_answer>
